Before the end of the year, Battlestate Games should also upgrade the engine to Unity 6 and add the End of the Line location, a new boss ( Povodyr ), ally knockdown and revive mechanics , first-person magazine loading animations, a simplified GPS navigation item, and the FAMAS and G3 rifles.

item.title: Pearl Abyss Is Researching The Feasibility of Crimson Desert Multiplayer, Yet More DLC Expansions And Follow-Up Projects Will Require The Right “Market Conditions”
item.description:
Following its smashing success , Pearl Abyss expanded Crimson Desert with the Charting the Unknown DLC , which adds epilogue stories for the three main characters and sea exploration, making the game an even bigger open-world action-adventure experience. While the Korean publisher has yet to say anything regarding future expansions, it did confirm in its 3Q26 Earnings Letter that a multiplayer mode of some sort is still on the table, although future DLC expansions are not guaranteed.

"As an action-packed open-world title, Crimson Desert has strong potential for long-term expansion into multiplayer. However, incorporating multiplayer is not simply a matter of adding another game mode; it requires a comprehensive approach that considers server infrastructure, game balance, cross-platform stability, and operational systems," the publisher said in a Q&A included in the latest earnings letter. "We are currently conducting research into both technical feasibility and gameplay mechanics, exploring ways for players to enjoy the Crimson Desert IP through a wider range of experiences. We will provide further updates through our official channels once these plans are finalized."

The addition of multiplayer in a game like Crimson Desert is definitely a massive undertaking, as mods have highlighted well already, so it's great to hear how Pearl Abyss is still researching the possibility. While some of the game's mechanics seem just perfect to create an MMO-lite experience, I would love to see combat-focused multiplayer, as the game already supports forming groups with Kliff , Damiane , and Oongka , which is almost a requirement to complete Charting the Unknown 's Garden of Trials challenges without overpowered builds.

Unfortunately, Pearl Abyss is not committing to future Crimson Desert DLC expansions. "Our priority remains centered on developing our next titles. Going forward, we plan to evaluate the expansion strategy for the Crimson Desert IP and the potential pipeline for follow-up projects by comprehensively assessing player feedback and market conditions," the developer said, suggesting that it will be sustained sales of Crimson Desert and the market performance of Charting the Unknown that will determine if the game is expanded further.

Although Crimson Desert 's future remains uncertain, Pearl Abyss is continuing to support it with post-launch updates. Patch 2.05.00 just went live today, fixing a variety of issues on all platforms and underscoring the publisher's commitment to delivering the best possible experience in what I firmly believe to be one of the best games of the year .

item.title: Massive Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot And More Worldwide As Recovery Remains Ongoing
item.description:
A massive Microsoft 365 outage has disrupted Outlook, Teams, Copilot, and numerous other Microsoft services worldwide , leaving businesses, government agencies, and millions of potential users facing connectivity problems. The disruption began on Thursday, November 12, and continued into Friday, with Microsoft still working to restore normal service availability .

According to Reuters , outage-tracking platform Downdetector recorded more than 130,000 reports of Outlook-related problems in the United States around 1 PM ET on Thursday . Tens of thousands of additional reports concerned Microsoft 365 , alongside thousands involving Teams . These figures represent user-submitted reports rather than a definitive count of affected customers .

What initially appeared to be an Exchange Online connectivity problem in the Americas quickly escalated into a worldwide disruption. Microsoft's service health dashboard identified two major incidents, EX1550543 and MO1550821 , involving mailbox connectivity and multiple Microsoft 365 services.

Affected users have reported difficulties accessing Outlook through desktop, web, and mobile clients, alongside delayed email deliveries. Other affected services and features include Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Defender XDR, Intune, Planner, and Microsoft Purview . However, not every feature is unavailable. For instance, core Teams messaging and calling functionality remains operational for many users, while Exchange Online-dependent features such as calendar management and meeting scheduling may fail.

Microsoft initially traced the problem to elevated infrastructure loads across multiple regions. However, the company subsequently determined that numerous servers had unexpectedly become unavailable, overwhelming the remaining infrastructure , rather than unusually high user traffic being responsible.

Engineers have been restarting affected servers, redistributing network traffic, and applying fixes to an authentication and routing configuration component. In its November 13 morning update, Microsoft reported incremental improvements but acknowledged that service capacity had not returned to normal. The company has also extended the email timeout window to 48 hours to help preserve delayed messages during recovery.

The disruption has extended beyond Microsoft's own applications. Both OpenAI and Anthropic reported issues with their Microsoft 365 connectors , potentially preventing users from establishing new connections or accessing Microsoft-connected functionality through their respective AI services.

The consequences have also been felt across several industries. Reuters reported disruptions affecting government agencies in Australia, Japan, and the United States, alongside airlines, financial institutions, and other businesses . Some companies postponed earnings announcements, while one Taiwanese financial firm reportedly resorted to confirming trades by fax.

This is hardly Microsoft's first major cloud-service disruption. Earlier in 2026, Microsoft 365 experienced another outage, while an Azure incident affected customers in October. Wccftech previously reported on a major Azure outage in October 2025 , which disrupted XBOX game downloads, Minecraft, and other services.

For now, Microsoft says it has found no evidence of malicious activity associated with the latest outage. Recovery efforts remain underway, and affected users and IT administrators can follow the company's official service health page for further updates.

News Source: Reuters

Interestingly, earlier Wccftech coverage highlighted how dataminers discovered Microsoft's XeO3 emulation technology powering the initial PC backward-compatibility rollout, raising the possibility of eventual XBOX 360 game support on Windows.

item.title: CD Projekt Red Has Already Targeted 2028 For The Witcher 4, and a New Legal Counsel Contract Points to April or May
item.description:
Earlier this year, CD Projekt Red confirmed that we will embark on a new journey with Geralt of Rivia with The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past expansion, showing the first steps of this journey during gamescom in August . Unfortunately, the Polish publisher also confirmed that The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release (likely due to the implementation of strict platform checkmarks ), which will also delay development of The Witcher remake . However, there's a very good chance that the next entry in the series will launch in the first half of the year.

"We're looking for an enthusiastic Legal Counsel to join the Business & IP division of the Legal Team at CD PROJEKT RED on a fixed-term contract until 30 April 2028," CD Projekt Red wrote in a new job ad . Among the responsibilities of the job is "providing ongoing legal advice on matters related to CD PROJEKT RED’s business, including asset clearance, terms & conditions, player communications and compliance of our products with applicable laws and regulations."

While the ad doesn't mention any specifics, the fixed-term contract until April 30, 2028 , and the provision of legal advice on asset clearance, player communications, and compliance with laws and regulations strongly suggest this role is related to an upcoming marketing campaign that will end in late April. As The Witcher 4 is confirmed to be the studio's next game, as the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel is still far from release, and The Witcher remake was always known to be coming after the fourth entry in the series, there's a very good chance that the game will be released close to the end of this contract.

Although this may sound like mere speculation, the chances of The Witcher 4 launching in May 2028 are rather high, given the connection between this job ad and CD Projekt Red 's release timing for the series. While the first entry in the series launched in October 2007 , both The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt launched in May , May 17, 2011 , and May 19, 2015 , respectively, so launching the fourth entry in the series in May 2028 would fit perfectly.

As The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past will likely be CD Projekt Red 's main focus until its launch next year, we are unlikely to see more of Ciri 's first adventure as a Witcher anytime soon. Hopefully, the final game will look every bit as good as the tech demo shared in 2025.

China has been incredibly resourceful in circumventing the U.S. export restrictions when discussing NVIDIA’s AI GPUs. Even though the chip manufacturer states that the trade sanctions have effectively driven its data center market share in the region down to zero, a new investigation reveals that more than $3.2 billion worth of computing projects are actively being built around the American firm’s restricted processors.

An independent review reveals that a total of 150 projects surrounding NVIDIA’s AI GPUs have been happening in China, hinting that it’s difficult to cut out the smuggling routes

We’ve previously discussed that NVIDIA’s H200 GPU shipments were being sent to China’s ghost offices , and now, Reuters has some of its own data to share. According to the media outlet, over 150 procurement notices, investment plans, construction contracts, and corporate disclosures have been unearthed, suggesting that there’s insatiable demand for restricted NVIDIA hardware and efforts from the U.S. to curb this activity are being nullified.

The $3.2 billion worth of computing projects included NVIDIA’s H100, H200, and H800 processors and were required by a multitude of Chinese firms. What’s interesting about the latest report is that these GPU shipments weren’t exclusively deployed by the country’s technology giants, as there has been a collective effort to ensure that the region prospers with access to this hardware.

NVIDIA’s AI GPUs have been found in local government-backed ventures, universities, and regional computing centers. One example of China’s drive to ensure its people benefit from these chips is a facility in northwestern Gansu province that’s supposedly being repurposed to house thousands of NVIDIA processors before the end of 2026. However, it hasn’t been smooth sailing for Chinese companies.

After all, trade limitations aren’t the only concern for these firms, as analysts note that there’s no confirmation that NVIDIA’s AI GPUs have actually reached the premises. Furthermore, project operators face expensive architectural redesigns centered on domestic Chinese chips if enforcement tightens further.

Then again, prior to Jensen Huang resigning from NVIDIA , a report came through that his alleged affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang materialized a $7.5 billion pipeline of AI GPUs reaching Chinese soil, with Jensen admitting in an interview that he doesn’t agree with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s stance concerning China’s chip ban, believing that America is all about creating competition.

It also doesn’t appear that Chinese companies prefer their in-house alternatives, particularly behemoths like Tencent, Alibaba, and ByteDance, and despite NVIDIA reportedly warning that it could take months for its RTX PRO 5500 shipments to be delivered, its overseas customers prefer waiting, showing how invaluable this hardware is to a swath of AI players.
